name: us-state-tax
description: Dependency-free US state individual income tax engine for tax years 2025 and 2026, covering 23 states including New York. Models what rate tables leave out: New York's supplemental tax, which claws back the benefit of the lower brackets so a high earner pays their top rate on their whole income; which federal figure each state starts from; which federal deductions it adds back; the six state earned income credits and the three that are not what they look like; and the credit phase-outs that make Utah's and Pennsylvania's flat taxes anything but flat. Every figure cited to the statute or state release it came from, and every carried-forward figure flagged as provisional.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize.mjs
